subject: English
title: My Mother At Sixty Six - CBSE Official Practice DPP

questions.question:
Which of these phrases uses the same poetic device as the following line from 
the extract? 
 
looked out at Young Trees sprinting...
options: that restaurant is as nice as the Big Fish
the pen became my highway to success
that fluffy cloud crying with sadness

the tall trees with many branches 
1
questions.explanation: CBSE English Core Practice Paper (PQ1) Marking Scheme: Option C.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the poet recalling the memory of the drive with the mother?
options: To provide a detailed account of her experience.
To demonstrate the correct idea of her mother's age.
To evoke a powerful image of the mother's ageing.

To convey her own emotions during the drive. 
1
questions.explanation: CBSE English Core Practice Paper (PQ2) Marking Scheme: Option C.

questions.question: Select the option that displays the most likely effect of the enjambment in the first three lines.
options: It creates a pause that highlights the speaker's emotions.
It suggests the continuity of the drive and the passage of time.
It creates a sense of tension and foreboding in the reader.

It suggests a sudden shift in the speaker's thoughts. 
1 
 OR
questions.explanation: CBSE English Core Practice Paper (PQ2) Marking Scheme: Option B.

questions.question: What is the poet’s purpose to employ contrast in the given lines?
options: To bring out the parallel between Aunt Jennifer's fear and the tigers' proud and unafraid prancing

To emphasise the fleeting nature of Aunt Jennifer's artistic creation compared to the enduring 
struggles of her life
To present the ability to create something beautiful, despite being surrounded by monotony.

To highlight the juxtaposition between Aunt Jennifer's mortality and the eternal, unafraid 
prancing of the tigers 
1
questions.explanation: CBSE English Core Practice Paper (PQ2) Marking Scheme: Option D.
